input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors.what: first smoke run of m42 crashed: the smoke mode skipped the H1 but the summary loop did not
errors.fix: loop over ROBOTS (G1 only in smoke); rerun clean

integrity_issues.what: milestone 41 (an earlier run) printed per-pose stacks against milestone 40's column computed in a different torque convention (spec plan with leg preload and squeeze vs raw 'hold-min'); its H1 per-pose losses 0.1-0.9 and a G1 0.2-point 'gain' were artefacts
integrity_issues.fix: m42 posthoc.txt computes both conventions; the LOG, README, PROPOSAL, paper and post state the like-for-like figures (H1 0.09-0.29 points); milestone 41's headline worst-pose numbers are unchanged because the conventions agree there

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py pytest numpy scipy mujoco does not install matplotlib, which every experiments/figure.py needs; one extra pip install

notes: Hypotheses H161-H164 registered and pushed (PR opened as draft) before the run. Local verification: project tests 212 passed, 4 skipped; reproduce.py --check m42_sides reproduces (91 lines); paper/check_numbers.py 341 of 341 (4 new); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links and check_md_links clean; post front matter, links and similarity clean. No agent doc in docs/reports: the LOG.md 'Next' line is where the next run of this programme looks.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a 2x2 rerun of an existing simulation, a post hoc convention check, write-up in five files and a blog post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
